Agent testing docs: simulation tests run multi-turn conversations with a simulated user driven by a natural-language scenario, with optional tool mocking.
Tests can be saved into suites and run singly, in batches or as a whole suite, with pass/fail; docs suggest running them in the development pipeline to catch regressions.
Probabilistic testing runs a test 3, 5 or 15 times (2 to 20 via API repeat_count) and reports a pass rate with failures grouped by reason.
An LLM evaluator judges next-reply tests against success criteria and examples; simulations use a success-condition prompt; tool parameters can be LLM-evaluated.
